title: The Household Animal
sentences: The domestic pet occupies a category our language handles badly.
It is neither property in any ordinary sense nor a member of the family.
Law treats it as the former; households behave as though it were the latter.
The contradiction surfaces at exactly the moments that matter most.
Decisions about a sick animal are made by someone it cannot argue with.
We describe these decisions in the vocabulary of mercy and mean it sincerely.
Sincerity does not resolve the asymmetry of power involved.
What makes the relationship valuable is partly what makes it uneasy.
An animal accepts our company without ever having consented to it.
Most affection between people is not offered on those terms.
